// ─── Platform adapters ──────────────────────────────────────

export interface PostAdaptation {
 platform: Platform;
 original: string;
 adapted: string;
 hashtags: string[];
 hashtags: string[];
}

/**
* Adapt content for a specific platform.
*
* Truncates to platform limits, adds platform-specific hashtags, adjusts emoji density.
*
* // OLLAMA: For richer adaptation, call Ollama with:
*   POST http://localhost:11434/api/run
*   body: {
*     model: "llama3",
*     messages: [
*       { role: "system", content: `Adapt this content for ${platform}...` },
*       { role: "user", content: content }
*     ]
*   }
*/
export function adaptForPlatform(platform: Platform, content: string, analysis: BrandAnalysis): PostAdaptation {
 const platformData = PLATFORM_DATA[platform] || PLATFORM_DATA.instagram;
 const maxChars = platformData.characterLimit;
 const adapted = truncateAndAdjust(content, platformData, analysis);
 const hashtags = generatePlatformHashtags(analysis.primaryKeywords, platform);

 return {
   platform,
   original: content,
   adapted,
   hashtags,
 };
}

function truncateAndAdjust(content: string, platformData: PlatformData, analysis: BrandAnalysis): string {
 const max = platformData.characterLimit;

 // Adjust emoji density based on brand voice
 const emojiDensity = voiceEmojiDensity(analysis.voice);
 const adjusted = emojiDensity === 'none' ? removeEmojis(content) : content;

 // Truncate if needed
 if (adjusted.length > max) {
   return adjusted.substring(0, max - 20) + '...';
 }

 return adjusted;
}

function voiceEmojiDensity(voice: VoiceProfile): 'none' | 'low' | 'medium' | 'high' {
 return platformData[voice]?.emojiDensity || 'medium';
}

function removeEmojis(text: string): string {
 return text.replace(/[🌍\u1f600-\u1f9FF\u2600-\u27BF\u27C0-\u27EF\uFE00-\uFE0F]/g, '');
}

// ─── Platform-specific hashtag generation ───────────────────

/**
* Generate platform-specific hashtags based on brand analysis.
*
* // OLLAMA: For smarter hashtag suggestions, call Ollama with:
*   POST http://localhost:11434/api/run
*   body: {
*     model: "llama3",
*     messages: [
*       { role: "system", content: "Generate the best hashtags for this brand and content on this platform" },
*       { role: "user", content: JSON.stringify({ brandName, keywords, platform }) }
*     ]
*   }
*/
export function generatePlatformHashtags(keywords: string[], platform: Platform): string[] {
 const max = getHashtagLimit(platform);
 const hashtags: string[] = [];

 // Add keyword hashtags
 for (let i = 0; i < keywords.length && hashtags.length < max / 2; i++) {
   hashtags.push(`#${keywords[i].replace(/\s+/g, '_')}`);
 }

 // Add platform-specific hashtags
 const platformTags: Record<Platform, string[]> = {
   instagram: ['#brand', '#marketing', '#business', '#growth', '#strategy'],
   twitter: ['#business', '#marketing', '#leadership', '#tech', '#ideas'],
   linkedin: ['#leadership', '#strategy', '#growth', '#business', '#innovation'],
   tiktok: ['#viral', '#trending', '#brand', '#content', '#growth'],
   facebook: ['#brand', '#community', '#share', '#discover', '#ideas'],
   youtube: ['#video', '#content', '#learning', '#brand', '#tips'],
 };

 for (let i = 0; i < platformTags[platform].length && hashtags.length < max; i++) {
   if (!hashtags.includes(platformTags[platform][i])) {
     hashtags.push(platformTags[platform][i]);
   }
 }

 return hashtags.slice(0, max);
}

function getHashtagLimit(platform: Platform): number {
 const limits: Record<Platform, number> = {
   instagram: 30,
   twitter: 2,
   linkedin: 5,
   tiktok: 3,
   facebook: 5,
   youtube: 3,
 };
 return limits[platform] || 5;
}

// ─── Format adapters ────────────────────────────────────────

/**
* Adapt post content to a specific format within a platform.
*
* // OLLAMA: Call Ollama with:
*   POST http://localhost:11434/api/run
*   body: {
*     model: "llama3",
*     messages: [
*       { role: "system", content: `Convert this content to ${format} format for ${platform}...` },
*       { role: "user", content: content }
*     ]
*   }
*/
export function adaptToFormat(
 platform: Platform,
 format: PostFormat,
 content: string,
 analysis: BrandAnalysis
): {
 adapted: string;
 formatted: string;
 metadata: { platform: Platform; format: PostFormat };
} {
 const adapted = adaptForPlatform(platform, content, analysis).adapted;
 const formatted = formatPost(adapted, format, platform);

 return {
   adapted,
   formatted,
   metadata: { platform, format },
 };
}

function formatPost(content: string, format: PostFormat, platform: Platform): string {
 switch (format) {
   case 'carousel':
     return formatCarousel(content, platform);
   case 'reel':
     return formatReel(content, platform);
   case 'story':
     return formatStory(content, platform);
   case 'post':
     return formatPost(content, platform);
   case 'video':
     return formatVideo(content, platform);
   case 'poll':
     return formatPoll(content, platform);
   case 'article':
     return formatArticle(content, platform);
   case 'highlight':
     return formatHighlight(content, platform);
   default:
     return content;
 }
}

function formatCarousel(content: string, platform: Platform): string {
 const lines = content.split('\n').filter(Boolean).slice(0, 5);
 return lines.map((line, i) => `${i + 1}. ${line}`).join('\n');
}

function formatReel(content: string, platform: Platform): string {
 return `[Video Script]\n\n${content}`;
}

function formatStory(content: string, platform: Platform): string {
 return `${content}\n\n— ${platform}`;
}

function formatPost(content: string, platform: Platform): string {
 return `${content}`;
}

function formatVideo(content: string, platform: Platform): string {
 return `[YouTube Video]\n\nTitle: ${content.substring(0, 60)}\n\nDescription:\n${content}`;
}

function formatPoll(content: string, platform: Platform): string {
 return `[Poll]\n\nQ: ${content}`;
}

function formatArticle(content: string, platform: Platform): string {
 return `[Article]\n\n${content}`;
}

function formatHighlight(content: string, platform: Platform): string {
 return `[Instagram Highlight]\n\n${content}`;
}

// ─── Publishing ──────────────────────────────────────────────

/**
* Publish post content to a platform.
*
* // OLLAMA: Before publishing, call Ollama with:
*   POST http://localhost:11434/api/run
*   body: {
*     model: "llama3",
*     messages: [
*       { role: "system", content: "Review this post before publishing. Check for brand consistency, appropriate tone, and platform suitability." },
*       { role: "user", content: JSON.stringify({ post, brandName, voice, tone }) }
*     ]
*   }
*/
export async function publishToPlatform(platform: Platform, post: ContentPost, analysis: BrandAnalysis): Promise<boolean> {
 // Step 1: Review with Ollama (optional)
 const review = await reviewPostBeforePublish(post, analysis);

 if (!review.approved) {
   console.warn(`Post review failed for ${platform}: ${review.reason}`);
   return false;
 }

 // Step 2: Adapt to platform
 const adapted = adaptForPlatform(platform, post.copy, analysis);
 const formatted = adaptToFormat(platform, post.format, post.copy, analysis).formatted;

 // Step 3: Publish (stub — integrate with actual platform APIs)
 console.log(`Publishing to ${platform}: ${formatted}`);
 console.log(`  Hashtags: ${adapted.hashtags.join(', ')}`);

 return true;
}

interface PostReviewResult {
 approved: boolean;
 reason: string;
 suggestions: string[];
}

async function reviewPostBeforePublish(post: ContentPost, analysis: BrandAnalysis): Promise<PostReviewResult> {
 // Stub review — in production, call Ollama for smart review
 return {
   approved: true,
   reason: 'Post looks good',
   suggestions: [],
 };
}
